parameters.name: AllowMajorVersionUpgrade
parameters.description: Specifies whether to enable [major engine version upgrade](~~127458~~) for the SQL Server instance. Valid values:

parameters.name: AutoUseCoupon
parameters.description: Specifies whether to use coupons to offset fees. Valid values:

parameters.name: BurstingEnabled
parameters.description:
Specifies whether to enable the [I/O performance burst feature for Premium ESSDs](~~2340501~~). Valid values:

- **true**: Enabled.
- **false**: Disabled.

parameters.name: Category
parameters.description:
The [instance edition](~~53509~~). Valid values:
> This parameter is required if **EngineVersion** is set to a SQL Server version number.
<details>
<summary>Regular ApsaraDB RDS instances</summary>

- **Basic**: Basic Edition
- **HighAvailability**: High-availability Edition
- **AlwaysOn**: SQL Server Cluster Edition
- **Cluster**: MySQL Cluster Edition.
- <props="china">**Finance**: Enterprise Edition</props>

</details>

<details>
<summary>Serverless ApsaraDB RDS instances (not supported for MariaDB)</summary>

- **serverless_basic**: Serverless Basic Edition (applicable only to MySQL and PostgreSQL)
- **serverless_standard**: Serverless High-availability Edition (applicable only to MySQL and PostgreSQL)
- **serverless_ha**: Serverless High-availability Edition (applicable only to SQL Server)

</details>

parameters.name: ColdDataEnabled
parameters.description: The [cold data archiving feature](~~2701832~~) for premium performance disks. Valid values:

parameters.name: CompressionMode
parameters.description: The MySQL [storage compression feature](~~2861985~~). Valid values:

parameters.name: DBInstanceClass
parameters.description: The [target instance type](~~26312~~). You can call [DescribeAvailableClasses](~~610393~~) to query the instance types to which the instance can be changed.

parameters.name: DBInstanceId
parameters.description: The instance ID. You can call [DescribeDBInstances](~~610396~~) to query the instance ID.

parameters.name: DBInstanceStorage
parameters.description: The [target storage capacity](~~26312~~). Unit: GB. You can call [DescribeAvailableClasses](~~610393~~) to query the available storage capacity range for the target instance type.

parameters.name: DBInstanceStorageType
parameters.description: The instance storage type. Valid values:

parameters.name: DedicatedHostGroupId
parameters.description: The dedicated cluster ID.

parameters.name: Direction
parameters.description:
The type of specification change. Valid values:

- **Up** (default): upgrade of a subscription instance or upgrade/downgrade of a pay-as-you-go instance.
- **Down**: downgrade of a subscription instance.
- **TempUpgrade**: elastic specification change of a subscription ApsaraDB RDS for SQL Server instance. This value is required for elastic specification changes.
- **Serverless**: configuration of elastic settings for a serverless instance.

> If you want to change only the **DBInstanceStorageType** parameter, for example, from standard SSD to ESSD, leave this parameter empty.

parameters.name: EffectiveTime
parameters.description:
The time when the new configurations take effect. Valid values:
> **Changing certain configurations may affect the instance**. Read the [impact section in the feature documentation](~~96061~~) before configuring this parameter. Perform this operation during off-peak hours.
* **Immediate** (default): The new configurations take effect immediately.
* **MaintainTime**: The new configurations take effect during the [maintenance window](~~610402~~).
* **ScheduleTime**: The new configurations take effect at a specified time. The specified time must be at least 12 hours later than the current time. The actual switchover time follows the rule: EffectiveTime = ScheduleTime + SwitchTime.

parameters.name: EngineVersion
parameters.description:
The database engine version. Valid values:
<details>
<summary>Regular ApsaraDB RDS instances</summary>

- MySQL: 5.5, 5.6, 5.7, 8.0
- SQL Server: 2008r2, 08r2\_ent\_ha, 2012, 2012\_ent\_ha, 2012\_std\_ha, 2012\_web, 2014\_std\_ha, 2016\_ent\_ha, 2016\_std\_ha, 2016\_web, 2017\_std\_ha, 2017\_ent, 2019\_std\_ha, 2019\_ent, 2022_web, 2022_std_ha, 2022_ent, 2025_std, 2025_ent
- PostgreSQL: 10.0, 11.0, 12.0, 13.0, 14.0, 15.0
- MariaDB: 10.3

</details>

<details>
<summary>Serverless ApsaraDB RDS instances (MariaDB is not supported)</summary>

- MySQL: 5.7, 8.0
- SQL Server: 2016\_std\_sl, 2017\_std\_sl, 2019\_std\_sl
- PostgreSQL: 14.0, 15.0, 16.0

</details>

parameters.name: IoAccelerationEnabled
parameters.description:
The [Buffer Pool Extension (BPE) feature](~~2527067~~) for premium performance disks. Valid values:

-  **1**: Enabled.
-  **0**: Not enabled.

parameters.name: OptimizedWrites
parameters.description: Specifies whether to enable the MySQL [16KB atomic write feature](~~2858761~~). Valid values:

parameters.name: PayType
parameters.description:
The billing method of the instance. Valid values:
- **Postpaid**: pay-as-you-go.
- **Prepaid**: subscription.
- **Serverless** (not supported for MariaDB instances): serverless billing method.

> To change the billing method to Serverless, you **must configure the following parameters**: automatic start and stop (AutoPause), scaling range (MaxCapacity and MinCapacity), and elastic policy (SwitchForce). For more information, see [Introduction to MySQL Serverless instances](~~411291~~), [Introduction to SQL Server Serverless instances](~~604344~~), and [Introduction to PostgreSQL Serverless instances](~~607742~~).

parameters.name: PromotionCode
parameters.description: The coupon code.

parameters.name: ReadOnlyDBInstanceClass
parameters.description: The [target instance type of read-only instances](~~276980~~) when you perform an Upgrade/Downgrade to change a MySQL high availability (HA) instance with Premium Local SSDs to a cloud disk instance. This parameter is active only when the instance meets the requirements.

parameters.name: ResourceGroupId
parameters.description: The resource group ID.

parameters.name: ServerlessConfiguration
parameters.description: The serverless instance configuration for the specification change.

parameters.name: SourceBiz
parameters.description: A deprecated parameter. You do not need to configure this parameter.

parameters.name: SwitchTime
parameters.description: The time at which the specification change is performed. **Perform the specification change during off-peak hours.**

parameters.name: TargetMinorVersion
parameters.description: The [minor engine version](~~126002~~) of the PostgreSQL instance. If the specification change fails because the minor engine version is not supported, specify this parameter to **upgrade the minor engine version during the specification change**.

parameters.name: UsedTime
parameters.description: The duration of the SQL Server [elastic upgrade](~~95665~~). Unit: days.

parameters.name: VSwitchId
parameters.description: The vSwitch ID. The zone of the vSwitch must correspond to the zone ID specified in **ZoneId**.

parameters.name: ZoneId
parameters.description: The zone ID.

parameters.name: ZoneIdSlave1
parameters.description: The zone ID of the secondary node. If this value is the same as **ZoneId**, the instance uses single-zone deployment. If this value is different from **ZoneId**, the instance uses multi-zone deployment.
